Subject: Throughput top-up & rate tier rebalancing for AvioCart

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I pulled together a short proposal for the hosted API commit top-up and a small rebalancing of your rate tiers to support the seasonal surge you described. High level:

- Current commit: 30M tokens/month (tier: silver)
- Proposed commit: 65M tokens/month (move to tier: gold)
- Burst window: +40% sustained for 72 hours monthly (soft cap, automatic smoothing)
- Effective per-1M token rate (post-discount): $85 (gold rate band)
- Implementation: 10 business-day lead once signed; migration window with traffic routing to dedicated pools for high-throughput endpoints

Attachments: avocart-proposal-2027-08.pdf (proposal + ops checklist).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Review pricing and burst window with finance (I included a baseline cost table in the attachment).
2) Confirm preferred start window (we can start the new commit on the 1st or 15th of a month).
3) If OK, I’ll send a DocuSign for the amendment and loop in Contracts for PO/terms.

If you want, we can keep the existing rate for low-volume endpoints and only bump the throughput-sensitive routes — that would reduce the incremental spend while preserving latency for your two highest-traffic routes.

Best,
Marcus

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the questions — Vanessa and I worked through ops and pricing. Short answers:

- Per-route pricing: checkout + recommendations (gold) at $85/1M. Remaining routes keep silver at $110/1M list but you keep the existing discount tier; net incremental blended rate per additional 35M is $92/1M. I attached a quick CSV breakout (avocart-pricing-breakdown-2027.csv).
- Overage behavior: soft-burst is allowed up to +40% for 72 contiguous hours; after the window, any additional sustained consumption will be billed at 1.4x the gold rate for that month (capped to prevent runaway spend). We will proactively notify when usage hits 85% of the new commit.
- SLA: Gold routes will be covered by our 99.9% latency SLO at the 95th percentile for text-generation endpoints. No change to uptime SLA for hosted API; credits unchanged.

If that all looks good I’ll push the amendment through DocuSign (link below). For Contracts: we require PO referencing RDW-DEAL-2027-AVC-0042 and standard commercial terms (30-day net).
